description: This file defines API endpoints related to recipe operations, including searching for recipes, fetching recipe details, and retrieving nutrition data. It utilizes FastAPI's routing and dependency injection mechanisms to set up HTTP GET endpoints that proxy requests to the Spoonacular API via a client.

methods.description: Performs a recipe search with optional diet filter, proxies request to SpoonacularClient.search_recipes.
